news.title: Mega Corporation Limited Announces Resignation of Shashwat Chaudhary as Company Secretary Cum Compliance Officer, Effective January 16, 2026
news.body: Mega Corporation Limited announced that Mr. Shashwat Chaudhary has resigned from the position of Company Secretary cum Compliance Officer due to personal reasons and to pursue opportunities outside the organization. In accordance with Clause 6 of his Appointment Letter dated March 12, 2025, Mr. Chaudhary served a notice period of 30 days, effective from December 17, 2025, and his last working day and relieving date was January 16, 2026. Mr. Chaudhary formally communicated his resignation to the Board of Directors and requested the Board to take note of his resignation and make necessary filings with the concerned authorities. The effective date of resignation was January 16, 2026.
